summary: Tested FMCC Site Audit Phase 1 (backend + frontend). Backend: AbilityGuard verified across all 124 parameterless GET routes (no ca/pa/ca_change/start_ca/goal_* keys), no 'potential +N'/'CA +N' text in notify/audit/changes/home/development/squad; squad progress {tone,text}; reports/compare rows have progress, no total_change; /api/home/extras returns 4 keys; HoF POST/PUT/GET/DELETE note works (cleaned up). Frontend: Home order correct (greeting, Up next, Highlights, What changed, Your modules, next match), modules collapse remembered after reload, home-ca-change shows '13 improving · 2 slipped back', tour starts with Home welcome step. Squad progress words, header sorting asc/desc, Default order reset, sort remembered, resize, row-click panel all work. Reports compare shows Progress words, no 'CA gained'. Scout Players shows 50 + sp-show-more reveals rest. Ctrl+K season/records search + navigation work. HoF induct/tribute/edit/remove work in UI. Game changes page shows potential in words. Found: Scout Players sort-by-Player 500 (HIGH), Player panel History chart now empty (stripped ca), Home still makes 4 duplicate extra requests, mobile scout card overlap, header/number misalignment.

critical.issue: 500 TypeError: bad operand type for unary -: 'str' (scout_api.py _filter line ~90 negates string sort value). Clicking the 'Player' heading in Scout Players (first click = desc) empties the table with no error shown. All other sort keys and name/asc return 200.

minor.issue: history[] items lost 'ca' via AbilityGuard, but PlayerPanel History tab still plots h.ca - history[0].ca -> 'Ability gained across saves' chart renders empty (NaN). Replace with progress words per save (server-side) or remove chart.
Every bell poll runs plans_api.development() for the goal notice plus breakout/elite checks; consider gating goal check by save signature like check_records.
In-process cache returns the same list object to callers; any caller mutating it corrupts the cache. Signature also ignores club name/branding edits.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Ability gained across saves' chart is empty (axis only) because history items no longer have ca

Stacked cards overlap: Player cell keeps desktop sticky position (position:sticky; left:42px; z-index:2; width 150px) and covers the Age cell (only 'e' of AGE visible); first cell (star/eye) also sticky. Sticky filter bar takes ~216px of 844px viewport and covers card tops.
When /scout/players errors the table silently shows 0 rows with no error message

integration_issues.issue: Home calls /api/home/extras but still fires /notify/countdowns, /celebrations, /history/record-watch, /watch/digest separately. RCA: useHomeExtras seeds cache in a parent useEffect, which runs after child useQuery mounts have already started fetching. Fix: seed cache inside the extras queryFn before returning (or pass data as props / initialData), and verify keys match the children's useGet keys.
go() swallows errors so .then(() => setEdit(null)) always runs; on a failed save the edit box closes and typed text is lost.

design_issues.screen: Scout Players / Club History Records / Monthly Reports 'My squad' table
issues: Numeric column headers are left-aligned while numeric values are right-aligned (Scout: all stat headers 'l'; Records: VALUE; Reports: Minutes/Goals/Assists/Rating). Scout Age values not right-aligned. Transfer Market/Development/Squad are correct.
'Progress since last save' label wraps to 2 lines and the value sits directly against the next row label (MINUTES) - tight spacing
Lists are capped at 50 by the backend so tm-show-more can never appear in the sample save (could not verify)
Empty lists show the note plus an empty table header

Filter appends 'season record hall of fame history' to every item, so typing 'season' or 'record' matches every history item (relevance noise); selecting a Players record lands on Records > Team sub-tab, not the record's sub-tab
Induct dropdown still lists already-inducted players; Remove has no confirm

Replace/remove PlayerPanel 'Ability gained across saves' chart that depends on stripped h.ca

Mobile card layout: reset position:sticky/left/z-index/width for sticky columns inside the <=640px tbl-std card CSS; consider non-sticky filter bar on phones
Right-align numeric headers in Scout Players, Records and Reports compare tables (and Scout Age cells)

Update stale tests: test_club_history.py::TestReads::test_leaders (leaders now include goals/assists/etc.) and test_qol_phase1.py::TestFinance::test_finance_items (new incoming/outgoing items)
critical_code_review_comments: AbilityGuard (BaseHTTPMiddleware) buffers and re-serialises every JSON response - works and is fast here (~130ms), but any frontend code still reading stripped keys silently breaks (found PlayerPanel h.ca). Grep frontend for remaining usages after each change.
NUM_TEXT only rewrites 'potential N'/'current ability N'; strings like 'CA +3' or 'PA 150' would pass through the guard - none found today.
induct uses $setOnInsert so re-inducting with a new note does not update it (PUT is the only path) - acceptable but undocumented.
Goal-reached notice could not be triggered end-to-end without altering ability data; only code-reviewed (notify_api.sync lines 142-148).

success_rate.backend: 95% (8/8 new tests pass; 1 HIGH bug found outside test list in scout sort)

rca of the issue: Scout 500: _filter sort key lambda does -(value or 0) for desc; value is a str for 'name'. Fix by using reverse=True for strings. Home duplicate requests: parent useEffect setQueryData runs after child queries mount and fetch. Empty History chart: server.py player_detail still puts 'ca' in history which AbilityGuard strips; frontend chart computes NaN.
